ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels to 15% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels, localized primarily at the peripheral margins and within discrete internal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity (black) boundary along the trailing edge and distal tips. Dense spatial distribution of dark circular mottling (rosettes) across the high-intensity (white) field. A high-contrast dark vertical band extends from the peduncle base toward the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 105 degrees and a high-depth bounding box relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary displays low-frequency, high-amplitude undulations near the tips and high-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations along the medial trailing edge. A distinct irregular indentation is visible on the upper-right trailing margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges exhibit a smooth convex curve tapering to acute tips, while the trailing edges follow a complex wavy/sinusoidal trajectory from the notch to the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of roughly circular, high-contrast dark pixel clusters (rings and solid spots) ranging from 5 to 25 pixels in diameter, most concentrated along the trailing edges and outer lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast yellowish-brown horizontal linear streaks are visible in the central-medial regions of both lobes; no high-contrast parallel rake marks are detected.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosette patterns) across the entire visible ventral surface; a specific traumatic notch or irregular tissue loss is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe (image-right).
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-ochre pigmentation staining localized in the mid-sections of the white ventral surface on both the left and right lobes.
